history.summary: Redesigned the storefront with larger photography, switchable collection scenes and alternate product previews. Added multi-image galleries for 369 more products; 563 of 2362 now have multiple verified photographs. Remaining source and configuration gaps are recorded. One mismatched source cover is withheld pending exact-size verification.

Added galleries with multiple distinct views for 194 products, plus thumbnail navigation, swipe and zoom. Remaining photo coverage is incomplete because of source access blocks and exact-configuration gaps.
Verified 15 exact Ghana retailer configurations and activated daily catalogue update task.
Added 17 manufacturer-verified current and upcoming products with exact source images. Removed arbitrary currency conversion.

checkScope: 17 launch records and 15 Ghana price variants; remaining registry entries await official-source checks.

gallery.note: Further verified manufacturer and exact-SKU retailer galleries were added. Bulk discovery stopped after repeated source timeouts and error responses; other sources returned access errors or exact-configuration gaps. Unrequested products remain pending. Wrong variants, accessory-only pictures and repeated views were excluded; existing covers remain where more photos are unavailable.

galleryChecks.notes: Saved shopping API could not be exercised in the preview database; persistence and pricing regression tests passed against a fresh migrated test database. Source access failures are retained in gallery-source-review.json.
